summary:
Implemented the SHACL path parser and its tests; no commits made.

Files:
- rdflib/extras/shacl.py (new): SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the spec's recursive procedure. Read-only graph access; list iteration via Graph.items.
- test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py (new): module-scoped Turtle fixture; valid-path parametrized test (operator-built expectations); invalid-path parametrized test covering every error branch plus cyclic rdf:rest (ValueError); None/plain-string test; graph-unchanged test.

Verification: `pytest test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py test/test_path.py` with the shared venv gives 42 passed. No lines exceed 88 columns.

Not verified: mypy (including unused-ignore checks) and black/isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and type-checking were reviewed by hand only.

Choice made: the runtime non-Node check goes through an object-typed alias to avoid a warn_unreachable error under mypy.
